text: {"v":1,"stage":"final","look":"First light: a drawn hillside of junipers going from the last of the night to full morning, with a clay cup on a sunlit table; flat shapes, soft light, plain","palettes":[["#f7f2e8","#20402f","#e3a53c","#c2562b"],["#f4ede1","#2a3550","#e9b25f","#b9512f"],["#f6efe4","#3b2a20","#d99a3a","#a8442a"]],"theirs":1,"width":1920,"height":1080,"fps":60,"background":"#f7f2e8","lang":"en","fonts":{"display":"fraunces","sans":"instrument-sans"},"scenes":[{"id":"dawn","name":"First light","dur":4.5,"desc":"Dark green hills before sunrise; a honey sun climbs over the ridge beside the title First Light."},{"id":"pour","name":"The pour","dur":4.5,"desc":"Coffee pours from a kettle into a terracotta cup on a sunlit table, and steam rises; the line reads Roasted at sunrise."},{"id":"notes","name":"Tasting notes","dur":4.5,"desc":"Honey, apricot and a juniper sprig arrive one by one, each over its name."},{"id":"end","name":"Juniper Coffee","dur":4.5,"desc":"End card: the same hills in full morning, the name Juniper Coffee underlined in terracotta, and where to order."}]}
